left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Frailᵃ male patients  [AND] with prostate cancer  [AND] who will start treatment with enzalutamide within label
  -  Age at least 18 years
  -  Patient who are able and willing to give written informed consent prior to screening
  -  Patients from whom it is possible to collect blood samples
  -  Patients who are willing to answer the questionnaires  [AND] and test
  -  Life expectancy of > 6 months
  -  Capable of understanding and answering Dutch tests  [AND] and questionnaires, as determined by the investigator
ᵃ Frail is defined as:
  -  a score on the comprehensive G8 assessment with cut-off ≤14 points and
  -  score ≥grade 1 for Central Nervous Disorders according to the Common Toxicity Criteria Adverse Event (CTCAE) criteria, of one of the following: Fatigue, [OR]  Concentration impairment, [OR]  cognitive disturbance, [OR]  amnesia, [OR]  depressed level of consciousness, [OR]  memory impairment, [OR]  hypersomnia

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  change in dose of opioids/ [OR] sedatives/ [OR] benzodiazepines during last 2 weeks before study)
  -  Use of psychostimulants such as methylphenidate within 1 week of start of study
  -  Diagnosed with medical conditions that affect cognition: Dementia, [OR]  Alzheimer disease, [OR]  Parkinson's disease, [OR]  psychiatric disorders that affect cognition other than depression  [OR] or anxiety complaints related to the disease
  -  Active infection  [OR] or other comorbidities that may contribute to REDOSE, February 2019 Page 7 of 53 fatigue  [OR] or cognition change within 4 weeks of study entry
  -  Clinical relevant anaemia
  -  MoCa score <20
  -  Hypersensitivity to the active substance  [OR] or to any of the excipients
